lines.en: I trot through the conifer wood.
My short legs move fast.
In the shade I move faster than the wind.
I hop over a fallen log.
I keep looking back as I go.
I round a pine tree.
My small body bounces along.
I head back toward my anchor.

lines.zh: 我踩着松针走进阴影里。
lines.en: I step into the shade over pine needles.
I walk over pine needles.
I quicken my pace again.
I hop a fern and keep going.
I sit with my ears up.
A little charge flickers in my fur.
I sit bolt upright, awaiting a word.
I'm counting the sounds of the wood.
I carry a charge when I run.
This wood is dark.
I look up at the branches.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴卷到爪子旁边。
lines.en: I curl my tail beside my paws.
I sit, not even my whiskers moving.
A spark jumps on my whisker tips.
My data flow is steady.

lines.zh: 松针落地的声音，我都听见。
lines.en: I can hear pine needles fall.
I look down at the ground again.
In this moment I'm quiet.
Have you come to take me in?
I raise my head, ears toward you.
Your hand rests there; I lean in to sniff.
I circle your feet and sniff.
You don't seem from here.
Where your shadow goes, I go.
I circle you, paws barely printing.
Call me and I'll run over.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子碰到你的指尖。
lines.en: My nose touches your fingertips.
Will you take me out of here?
Your smell is fixed in me.
I sit slowly, well behaved.
If you walk, I'm right behind.
I rest my head by your leg.

lines.zh: 我发出一点细小的电鸣。
lines.en: I make a tiny electric chirp.
I prick my ears for your words.
I leap away with a cry.
My sparks flare once and go out.
I hide behind a pine root.
I can bear this pain.
I shudder and my fur puffs out.
My spark patterns jump out of place.
My heartbeat is the current.
I'll keep this one between my teeth.
I prop up my forelegs and stand.
I lift my face to you again.
Is that food? Let me see.
I come running on all four paws.
I like this smell.
I take a careful small bite.
I wag my tail as I eat.
This much will grow me a bit.
The scent lingers between your fingers.
I lick the crumbs from my muzzle.
Just a little more.
I crouch by your boot and nibble.
Thank you; I'm content.
This taste is warm.
Your hand comes near and I spring off.
I'm small; I won't hurt you.
I slip between your legs.
Pine needles scatter underfoot.

lines.zh: 我耳朵里的脉冲，还在跳。
lines.en: The pulse in my ears still beats.
I steady myself and stand.
One bump and a shake of fur is all.
I run back to your side.

lines.zh: 静电让你的衣角立起来。
lines.en: Static lifts the hem of your coat.
I press against your shin and stay.
Another small shape comes near.

lines.zh: 两只小兽，挤在同一片阴影。
lines.en: Two small beasts in the same patch of shade.
It's a little smaller than me.
We run through the pines together.

lines.zh: 我们坐在同一个树根上。
lines.en: We sit on the same root.

lines.zh: 它身上的电光一闪一闪。
lines.en: Its sparks flicker on and off.
We sit together waiting for someone.
The wind in the wood is cool.
In this moment I don't want to move.
Tomorrow I'll come here again.
I clamp it in my teeth.
I nudge it to your boot tip.
This one is a little hard.
It's bitter, but I swallow it.

lines.zh: 脉冲兽的爪，压得死死的。
lines.en: Pulsemon's paw pins it flat.
I carry it as I run.
It's heavy; I drag it.
I hide it under a root.
I tuck this into my fur.
I run back to find you.
A pinecone drops; I look up.
My ears snap upright.
I push up out of my sit.
That one looks wrong.
I run that way.
My paws move first.

lines.zh: 毛都竖起来了，电流在跳。
lines.en: Fur standing up, current jumping.
Charge gathers between my teeth.
It's within a few paces.
Fine, I pick that one.
Current runs up my spine.
I bring my belly toward the ground.
I creep forward in little steps.
I slip round by the roots.

lines.zh: 我的小爪子踩碎了松针。
lines.en: My small paws crush the pine needles.
Belly to the pine needles, I creep.
It turns; I freeze.
I wait for it to show a gap.
It's backed to a pine.
I inch half a foot closer.
This distance is right.
I hold the air in my chest.

lines.zh: 电流在我腿里跑，一蹬就出。
lines.en: Current runs down my legs; one kick and it fires.
My hind legs kick off.
I lunge and strike.
My claws rake across.
My current runs through my teeth.
It's shoved back a pace.
Pine needles fly up.
I leap back and grip the ground.
My sparks flare once.
Even a small bite carries lightning.
I add one more blow.
I release my bite and step off.
I run back to your side.
I lunge; pine needles scatter.
I leap out of the data stream.
The wood glimmers; I'm here.
Pulsemon has appeared.
I land a little ahead of my anchor.
Faint light flickers along my fur.
I run out from between the pines.
It's dark here; I like it.
I tip my head up at your face.
My data has settled.
I sit with my tail round my feet.

lines.zh: 我的小爪子踩在松针上。
lines.en: My small paws press the pine needles.
My charge still clings to the pine needles.

lines.zh: 烧焦的味道，我自己闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell my own singed fur.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall from a tree and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我呛得直咳。
lines.en: Water in my nose makes me cough.
My pulses cut out, and I land on my back.

lines.zh: 一支箭削掉我耳尖的毛。
lines.en: An arrow shears the fur from my ear tip.

lines.zh: 咒力搅乱了我体内的电流。
lines.en: The spell scrambles the current inside me.
I can't even spark anymore.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我身上的电都跳了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my sparks jump.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我扒不到东西。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot, and nothing to claw.
